bullets.text: Spring Statement 2026 Insights - The Spring Statement highlights upcoming changes in tax compliance for small businesses starting April 2026.
MTD Opportunity for Fintechs - Making Tax Digital for Income Tax presents a chance for fintechs to enhance customer engagement.
New Penalty Regime Explained - HMRC's new penalty systems for MTD aim to encourage timely submissions and better compliance.
Embedded Accounting Rising - Financial institutions are prioritising embedded accounting to meet small business needs for seamless operations.
Accountants Must Prepare - Landlords will face MTD for Income Tax requirements, necessitating proactive preparation from accountants.
AI in Accounting Guidelines - Updated guidance on AI use in accounting emphasizes integrity, objectivity, and client data protection.
